purpose: Teach: ピクセル/後味/サビ/霞/無防備/お嬢様/遭う/たった今

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、レトロな、本気で、絶対、ピクセル、絶対、ゲーム、絶対、お前、絶対、好きでしょ?本気で
lines.en: Riku, you absolutely love retro pixel games, don't you? I'm serious.
lines.style: Bright, teasing lilt on the opening. Playful accusation — she's calling him out on something obvious. Quick pace, almost singing the question. Lands gently on the final assertion.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。給食の、本気で、絶対、後味、絶対、なんか、絶対、いまいちだったぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Lunch had a weird aftertaste though, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, deflecting. Throws out the non-sequitur about lunch to sidestep her teasing. Wry smile in the voice. Relaxed, almost lazy delivery — he's used to being called out.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、好きな曲の、絶対、サビ、絶対、いつも、絶対、口ずさんでるよね、リク
lines.en: You're always humming the chorus of your favourite song, aren't you, Riku?
lines.style: Softer observation, not accusation this time. Gentle noticing — she's caught him in a quieter habit. Slower pace, almost thoughtful. The kind of comment that lands closer than he expects.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 朝、本気で、絶対、霞、絶対、かかってて、絶対、雰囲気、絶対、よかったぜ、桜
lines.en: This morning was nice though — all that mist, the whole atmosphere was good, Sakura.
lines.style: Reflective, a little distant. He's not quite meeting her eye with this one — it's genuine but sideways. Quieter than before. Soft attack on 'This morning.' He's thinking about something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、授業中、絶対、無防備、絶対、な、絶対、寝顔、絶対、してたよ、リク
lines.en: You were sleeping in class with your guard completely down, weren't you? I saw you like that, Riku.
lines.style: Teasing warmth underneath. She's not making fun — she's noticing something tender about him. Medium pace, almost a giggle threading through. The 'I saw you' lands like a small confession.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: クラスの、本気で、絶対、新しい子、絶対、お嬢様、絶対、っぽい雰囲気、絶対、あるよな、桜
lines.en: There's a new girl in class, you know. She's got that princess-like vibe going on, doesn't she?
lines.style: Casual observation, fishing a little. He's dropping this like it doesn't matter, but the timing is pointed. Light pace, almost too relaxed — a tell. Lets the question hang.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日、本気で、絶対、駅前で、絶対、お前のお父さんに、絶対、遭う、絶対、ことがあったよ、リク
lines.en: Yesterday I actually ran into your dad at the station, Riku.
lines.style: Animated, energetic — she's sharing something she found surprising or funny. Quick attack. Bright delivery, like she's delighted to have this detail. Lands the 'your dad' with warmth, almost conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: たった今、本気で、絶対、お前から、絶対、メッセージ、絶対、届いたぜ、桜
lines.en: I literally just got a message from you right now, Sakura.
lines.style: Animated, caught-off-guard energy. Quick, almost urgent opening. He's realised something — maybe embarrassed, maybe amused at the timing. The contradiction lands with a small, genuine laugh underneath.
